mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the CPIAUCSL index over the past month signals accelerating inflation, compressing real returns on equities and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in >60% of instances despite CPIAUCSL rising by >2% month-over-month, or Rank IC exceeds 0.05 over a 6-month window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in UNRATE below 3.5% triggers a positive S&P 500 forward return over the next 20 trading days as lower unemployment signals stronger labor market growth and corporate optimism.
failure_condition: UNRATE crosses below 3.5% but S&P 500 returns remain negative, or the effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05 in regression).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in GDPC1 (demand) and decline in HOUST (demand activity) indicates weakening demand growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 rises and HOUST falls but S&P 500 returns are positive, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05 in multivariate regression).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a sustained rise in FEDFUNDS above 2.5% triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as preemptive tightening signals impending economic slowdown.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS rise above 2.5% in late-cycle but S&P 500 returns remain positive, or the effect is not significant (p > 0.05 in t-test).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in PAYEMS (job creation) over the past month predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as strong labor demand boosts corporate profits and investor confidence.
failure_condition: PAYEMS rises but S&P 500 returns remain negative, or the relationship is not statistically significant (p > 0.05 in regression).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in INDPRO below 108 signals weakening supply-side growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as reduced production capacity dampens economic momentum.
failure_condition: INDPRO falls below 108 but S&P 500 returns are positive, or the effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05 in t-test).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in GDPC1 (demand) and decline in INDPRO (supply) indicates conflicting growth signals, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as market uncertainty persists.
failure_condition: GDPC1 rises and INDPRO falls but S&P 500 returns are positive, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05 in multivariate regression).

mechanism_narrative: In a post-recession recovery, a sustained drop in FEDFUNDS below 1.5% triggers positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as accommodative monetary policy supports economic expansion.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS fall below 1.5% in post-recession but S&P 500 returns remain negative, or the effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05 in t-test).
